name: Steel City Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Steel City Securities Ltd provides stock broking and e-governance services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of retail stock 
 broking operations in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Orissa, Chattisgarh, and Maharashtra. It provides a trading platform for **Capital Market, Futures & Options, Commodities and Currency Derivatives from NSE, BSE, MCX, MSE, and NCDEX. **

pros: Stock is trading at 1.07 times its book value
Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 4.23%.
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 38.0%
Promoter holding has increased by 0.83% over last quarter.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.34% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 11.6% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 340 days.
Working capital days have increased from 43.0 days to 145 days
